(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (row-nz r)
      (filter (lambda (cv) (not (= (second cv) 0)))
              (map (lambda (c) (list c (at g r c))) (range (cols g)))))
    (define (count-color cells color)
      (length (filter (lambda (cv) (= (second cv) color)) cells)))
    (define (payload-row? r)
      (let ((nz (row-nz r)))
        (and (= (length nz) 2)
             (= (second (first nz)) (second (second nz)))
             (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0))
                   (range (+ (first (first nz)) 1) (first (second nz)))))))
    (define (key-row? r)
      (let ((nz (row-nz r)))
        (and (= (length nz) 3)
             (= (count-color nz 8) 2)
             (= (count-color nz 5) 1)
             (let* ((eights (filter (lambda (cv) (= (second cv) 8)) nz))
                    (selector (first (filter (lambda (cv) (= (second cv) 5)) nz))))
               (and (< (first (first eights)) (first selector))
                    (< (first selector) (first (second eights))))))))
    (define (nth xs n)
      (if (= n 0) (first xs) (nth (rest xs) (- n 1))))
    (define key-row (first (filter key-row? (range (rows g)))))
    (define key-nz (row-nz key-row))
    (define left-key (first (filter (lambda (cv) (= (second cv) 8)) key-nz)))
    (define selector (first (filter (lambda (cv) (= (second cv) 5)) key-nz)))
    (define rank (- (first selector) (first left-key)))
    (define payload-rows (filter payload-row? (range (rows g))))
    (define chosen-row (nth payload-rows (- rank 1)))
    (define chosen (row-nz chosen-row))
    (paint-cells
      g
      (map (lambda (c) (list chosen-row c))
           (range (first (first chosen)) (+ (first (second chosen)) 1)))
      (second (first chosen)))))
